brand.name: Green Empire Builders
brand.tagline: Long Island's Premier Home Builder & General Contractor
brand.footerTagline: Long Island's trusted general contractor & home builder. Licensed, insured, and locally based in Nassau & Suffolk Counties.
brand.heroSubtext: Your home is your biggest investment — we treat it that way. Green Empire Builders delivers custom home additions, renovations, kitchens, bathrooms, and new construction across Long Island with craftsmanship that lasts.
brand.servicesSubtext: From kitchen remodels and home additions to full custom builds — professional construction for Long Island homeowners.

services.name: Home Additions
services.description: Expand your living space with a professionally designed and built home addition — first-floor extensions, second-story additions, and room expansions built to match your existing structure.
services.heroText: Need more space but love your neighborhood? Green Empire Builders designs and constructs seamless home additions for Long Island homeowners — built to code, on budget, and finished to the highest standard.
bullets: Second-story additions and full floor expansions
Full architectural planning and permit coordination
services.tagline: Room additions, second-story additions, dormers and extensions from a family-owned Long Island contractor.
covers: Room additions
A new room off the back or side of the house: a bigger kitchen, a family room or a primary suite.
Second-story additions
A full or partial second story, for more bedrooms without giving up the yard.
Dormers
More headroom and floor space upstairs, for a bedroom or a bathroom under the roof.
Home extensions
Smaller bump-outs and extensions that add a few feet where you need them.
services.pricing: An addition depends on its size and design and on the house it joins, so we price it after we've seen the house and talked through what you want. You get one written price before any work starts.
services.priceFactors: Your price depends on the size of the addition, the design and the finishes you pick.
faqs: How long does an addition take?
A single-story room addition usually takes 3 to 4 months, and a full second-story addition 4 to 6 months. We'll give you a timeline for yours at the first visit.
Can we stay in the house?
Usually, yes, for a room addition or a dormer. A second-story addition can mean moving out for part of the job, and we'll tell you at the first visit.
What happens at the first visit?
We come to your home, look at the house and the space you want to add, and talk through the design and your budget. You get a written quote after.
How is the price set?
By the project. It depends on the size of the addition, the design and the finishes you choose, and you get it in writing before work starts.

services.name: Kitchen Remodeling
services.description: Transform your kitchen into the heart of your home — custom cabinetry, premium countertops, updated layouts, and modern finishes designed around how you actually cook and live.
services.heroText: A kitchen remodel is one of the best investments a Long Island homeowner can make. Green Empire Builders handles every detail — from demolition to the final cabinet hardware — so your new kitchen is exactly what you envisioned.
services.tagline: Full kitchen remodels, new cabinets and countertops, and new layouts from a family-owned Long Island contractor.
covers: Full kitchen remodels
A full renovation: cabinets, countertops, backsplash, flooring and lighting, planned and built as one project.
Cabinets and countertops
New cabinets and countertops, keeping the layout you have now.
A new layout
Adding an island or moving the sink and appliances, planned with you at the first visit.
Backsplash, floors and lighting
A new backsplash, floor and lighting to finish the room.
services.pricingTitle: How we price a kitchen remodel
services.pricing: Every kitchen is different, so we price the project after we've seen the room and you've told us what you want. You get one written price before any work starts.
services.priceFactors: Your price depends on the size of the kitchen, the layout and the cabinets, counters and finishes you pick.
faqs: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
A full kitchen usually takes 5 to 8 weeks once work starts. We'll give you a timeline for yours at the first visit.
Can we stay in the house?
Yes. Most families stay home during a kitchen remodel, and we keep the work area closed off.
What happens at the first visit?
We come to your home, measure the kitchen, look at what's there now and talk through what you want: the layout, the cabinets and counters, and your budget. You get a written quote after.
How is the price set?
By the project. It depends on the size of the kitchen, the layout and the materials you choose, and you get it in writing before work starts.

services.name: Bathroom Remodeling
services.description: Upgrade your bathroom from dated to stunning — custom tile work, walk-in showers, new vanities, and complete layout redesigns handled by an experienced Long Island crew.
services.heroText: Whether it's a master bath overhaul or a guest bathroom refresh, Green Empire Builders brings the same attention to detail to every project. We handle permits, plumbing coordination, tile work, and every finish in between.
services.tagline: Full bathroom remodels and walk-in shower conversions from a family-owned Long Island remodeling contractor.
covers: Full bathroom remodels
A full renovation, down to the studs where the room needs it: layout, tile, fixtures, vanity and lighting, handled as one project.
Tub to walk-in shower
The tub comes out and a tiled walk-in shower goes in its place, finished with a glass door or panel.
Floor and wall tile
New tile on the floor, the walls and the shower, set on a waterproofed base.
Vanities and fixtures
A new vanity, mirror, toilet and lights, fitted to the room.
services.pricingTitle: How we price a bathroom remodel
services.pricing: Every bathroom is different, so we price the project after we've seen the room and you've told us what you want. You get one written price before any work starts.
services.priceFactors: Your price depends on the size of the room, the layout and the materials you pick.
faqs: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
A full bathroom usually takes 3 to 5 weeks once work starts. We'll give you a timeline for yours at the first visit.
Do I need to move out?
Usually not. If it's your only bathroom, we plan the work around that with you before we start.
What happens at the first visit?
We come to your home, measure the room, look at what's there now and talk through what you want: the layout, the materials and your budget. You get a written quote after.
How is the price set?
By the project. It depends on the size of the room, the layout and the materials you choose, and you get it in writing before work starts.

services.name: Dormer Construction
services.description: Add square footage, natural light, and headroom to your attic with a professionally built dormer — one of the most cost-effective ways to expand your Long Island home.
services.heroText: Dormers add space, light, and value without the footprint of a full addition. Green Empire Builders has built dozens of dormers across Long Island — from shed dormers that open up an entire floor to custom designs that match your home's character.
bullets: Shed dormer and gable dormer construction
services.tagline: Shed and gable dormers that add headroom, light and usable space upstairs, from a family-owned Long Island contractor.
covers: Shed dormers
A long dormer across the back or front of the roof, adding the most headroom and floor space upstairs.
Gable dormers
A peaked dormer that adds light, headroom and character to a bedroom under the roof.
Full attic conversions
A dormer built as part of a full attic conversion, with framing, insulation, drywall and finishes handled as one project.
Windows and exterior finishing
Window installation and exterior finishing matched to your existing roof and siding, with structural engineering and permits coordinated.
services.pricing: Every dormer depends on the roof it joins and the room it creates, so we price the project after we've seen the house and talked through what you want. You get one written price before any work starts.
services.priceFactors: Your price depends on the size and type of dormer, the structure of your roof and the finishes you pick.
faqs: How long does a dormer take?
It depends on the size of the dormer and the work inside. We'll give you a timeline for yours at the first visit, before any work starts.
Can we stay in the house?
Usually, yes. Most dormer work happens at the roof while you stay in the house, and we'll tell you at the first visit if any part means otherwise.
What happens at the first visit?
We come to your home, look at the roof and the upstairs space, and talk through the design and your budget. You get a written quote after.
How is the price set?
By the project. It depends on the size and type of dormer, your roof's structure and the finishes you choose, and you get it in writing before work starts.

services.name: Basement Finishing
services.description: Turn your unfinished basement into livable square footage — home offices, playrooms, entertainment spaces, or guest suites built with proper waterproofing, egress, and code compliance.
services.heroText: An unfinished basement is wasted potential. Green Empire Builders transforms Long Island basements into fully finished, code-compliant living spaces — from framing and waterproofing through flooring, lighting, and final finishes.
services.tagline: Unfinished basements finished and old basements redone, by a family-owned Long Island remodeling contractor.
covers: Finishing an unfinished basement
Framing, insulation, drywall, flooring and lighting, turning bare concrete and studs into a finished room.
Basement remodels
A basement renovation for a space that's already finished but dated, or laid out wrong for how you live now.
A basement bathroom
A full or half bathroom added downstairs.
Family rooms, offices and guest rooms
The space planned around how you'll use it: a family room, a home office, a gym or a guest room.
services.pricing: Every basement is different, so we price the project after we've seen the space and you've told us how you want to use it. You get one written price before any work starts.
services.priceFactors: Your price depends on the size of the space, what's there now and the finishes you pick.
faqs: How long does it take to finish a basement?
Most basements take about 7 to 12 weeks once work starts. We'll give you a timeline for yours at the first visit.
What if my basement gets damp?
If we see signs of water at the first visit, we tell you before anything is built, because it has to be dealt with first.
What happens at the first visit?
We come to your home, measure the space, look at what's there now and talk through how you want to use it and your budget. You get a written quote after.
How is the price set?
By the project. It depends on the size of the space, what's there now and the finishes you choose, and you get it in writing before work starts.

A full renovation across several rooms, taken back and rebuilt with new finishes throughout.
Open floor plans

services.pricingTitle: How we price a full home renovation
services.pricing: A full home renovation depends on the size of the home and how much is being rebuilt, so we price the project after we've seen the house and talked through the scope with you. You get one written price before any work starts.
services.priceFactors: Your price depends on the size of the home, the scope of the renovation and the finishes you pick.
faqs: How long does a full home renovation take?
It depends on the scope — a multi-room renovation usually runs several months once work starts. We'll give you a timeline for yours at the first visit.
Can we stay in the house during the work?
Sometimes, if the work can be phased room by room. For a full gut renovation, most families move out for part of the job — we'll tell you honestly at the first visit.
What happens at the first visit?
We come to your home, walk the whole house with you, look at what's there now and talk through the scope and your budget. You get a written quote after.
How is the price set?
By the project. It depends on the size of the home, the scope and the finishes you choose, and you get it in writing before work starts.

services.name: Custom Home Building
services.description: Build the home you've always wanted, exactly the way you want it — custom design, premium materials, and hands-on project management from foundation to final key.
services.heroText: Building a custom home on Long Island is one of the most significant decisions you'll make. Green Empire Builders guides you through every phase — site prep, design, permits, construction, and finishing — with full transparency and no surprises.
services.tagline: Ground-up custom homes designed and built on Long Island, managed end to end by one team.
services.coversTitle: What building a custom home covers
covers: Custom design and planning
Custom architectural design and planning around how you want to live, before anything is built.
Permits and approvals
Full permit coordination and approvals handled as part of the project.
Foundation and framing
Foundation, framing and structural work built to code and inspected at every stage.
Premium finishing
Premium interior and exterior finishing, with end-to-end project management from one team.
services.pricingTitle: How we price a custom home
services.pricing: A custom home depends on its size, design and the lot it sits on, so we price the project after we've talked through your plans and budget. You get one written price before any work starts.
services.priceFactors: Your price depends on the size and design of the home, the lot and the finishes you pick.
faqs: How long does it take to build a custom home?
It depends on the size and design of the home. We'll give you a realistic timeline at the first meeting, before anything is signed.
Do I need my own architect?
No. We handle custom architectural design and planning as part of the project — and if you already have plans, we can build from those too.
What happens at the first meeting?
We sit down and talk through what you want to build, where, and your budget, and look at the lot if you have one. You get a written quote after.
How is the price set?
By the project. It depends on the size and design of the home, the lot and the finishes you choose, and you get it in writing before work starts.

faqs.q: What areas of Long Island do you serve?
faqs.a: Green Empire Builders serves Nassau and Suffolk Counties including Massapequa, Merrick, Bellmore, Wantagh, Seaford, Freeport, Baldwin, Oceanside, Rockville Centre, Levittown, Amityville, Lindenhurst, Babylon, and more. Not sure if we cover your area? Call or text us at (516) 595-0684.

faqs.q: How do I know what my renovation will cost?
faqs.a: Every project is different, which is why we start with a free on-site consultation. We assess the scope, your goals, and your property before providing a detailed written quote. Factors that affect cost include square footage, material selections, structural changes, and permit requirements. We never start work without your full pricing approval.

faqs.q: Should I remodel or move to a bigger home?
faqs.a: In most cases, a well-planned renovation or addition is more cost-effective than buying a larger home on Long Island. You keep your location, your neighborhood, and your equity while gaining the space and features you want. We can help you evaluate whether an addition, a second story, or a full renovation makes the most sense for your situation.

Yes. Permit coordination is included in every project. We manage the full permitting process with your local building department so you do not have to. Work begins only after all required approvals are in place.

faqs.q: Can I add a second story to my existing home?
faqs.a: Yes. Second-story additions are one of our specialties. We assess your existing foundation and structure, coordinate engineering if needed, and build the addition to match the character of your home. Most Long Island homes are good candidates. We will give you an honest assessment at the consultation.

Yes. Green Empire Builders is fully licensed and insured in New York State. We carry comprehensive general liability insurance and workers compensation on every project, and we coordinate all permits through your local municipality.

faqs.q: How long does a typical remodeling project take?
faqs.a: Timelines depend on scope. A bathroom remodel typically takes 2 to 4 weeks. A kitchen renovation runs 4 to 8 weeks. A home addition or second story can take 3 to 6 months. We provide a realistic timeline before work begins and keep you updated throughout.

faqs.q: Do I need to move out during construction?
faqs.a: In most cases, no. For kitchen and bathroom remodels or room additions, most homeowners stay in the home during construction. For full gut renovations or major structural work, temporary relocation may be needed for a portion of the project. We will be upfront about this during the consultation so you can plan accordingly.

faqs.q: How much contingency budget should I set aside?
faqs.a: A standard recommendation is 10 to 15 percent of your total project budget. Renovation projects can uncover unexpected conditions once work begins, particularly in older Long Island homes. We do our best to identify potential issues during planning, but having a contingency in place means no surprises derail your project.
